title: NomosHostApproval
description: Nomos-owned assertion contract at execution_context.data.host_approval. Valid shape is not proof of human approval; configured source, exact operation, trust, replay and current policy checks remain required.

version.description: Nomos assertion-format version. JSON numeric forms equal to integer 1 are accepted; booleans are not.

source.description: Host application identity that must exactly match the operator-configured trusted source. It is an identifier, not authentication.

approval_id.description: Nonblank opaque human-approval identifier consumed by the activation-scoped Nomos replay journal.

tool_name.description: Exact guarded local tool name covered by the approval and enabled in operator configuration.

approved_arguments.description: Exact business arguments approved by the host, compared structurally with the held call after removing only the top-level nomos review field.
